summary: Frontend-only testing for Torillaz ERP Fase 8 (HR & Payroll) + Fase 9 (Dashboard & Laporan). All critical flows PASS. Dashboard KPIs (Omzet Bulan/Hari, Laba Kotor, Piutang, Total Produksi) render with real values; Tren Omzet chart & Produk Terlaris present. Sidebar submenu HR & Payroll (Data Karyawan/Absensi/Kasbon/Penggajian) and Laporan visible. Absensi bulk save persists status Alpha and lembur=2 across reload. Kasbon add (KSB-0002 Rp 300.000), partial bayar (sisa Rp 200.000), and delete all working with proper toasts + total aktif KPI updates. Payroll view detail dialog, Download Slip PDF (no JS errors), and Bayar Draft slip (Budi) with rekening pick -> status berubah 'Dibayar' (Dibayar count 2). Laporan tabs (Penjualan/Laba-Rugi/Persediaan/Produksi/Payroll) semua load; Export Excel + PDF pada Penjualan/Persediaan/Produksi/Payroll dan Export PDF Laba/Rugi tidak melempar error. Filter tanggal Penjualan berfungsi. Navigasi antar submenu tanpa blank/error.
critical_code_review_comments: LaporanPage.js: testId for Persediaan export is 'rep-stok-export' (not 'rep-inv-export' as mentioned in agent context). Consider aligning naming convention (rep-inv- vs rep-stok-) to reduce confusion for downstream testers.

Absensi persistence: leftover test state (Alpha status + lembur=2) was reset by testing agent; agent context noted 'jangan hapus data master' - absensi/attendance row-level records are transactional and safe to overwrite; consider adding a 'clear per-date' helper if scope grows.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_ kasbons during test (KSB-0002, KSB-0003) — all cleaned up. Absensi 2026-07-31: Budi/Siti reset to Hadir, lembur 0 after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Fase 8 + 9 flows validated end-to-end from UI. Correct Laporan export testIds: rep-sales-export-(btn|excel|pdf), rep-stok-export-* (NOT rep-inv-), rep-prod-export-*, rep-payroll-export-*, rep-lr-pdf. Payroll periode 2026-07 now has both Budi Santoso + Siti Aminah = Dibayar. Use different periode if you need Draft slips again. Absensi 2026-07-31 currently Budi=Hadir/Siti=Hadir both lembur=0.
